name: Wirehawk
description:
About This Game

Wirehawk combines the aesthetics of classic vector games with modern, precise mouse control - a level of control and speed a gamepad simply can't match. It brings back the arcade shmup of the golden age, redrawn in glowing vector lines on pure black. You just fly; your laser never stops firing. Your ship goes exactly where your hand goes, with full gamepad support when you want it. Fight your way up through the stages of distinct neon worlds, face a boss every tenth stage, and push your laser from a single beam to a screen-filling fan of twenty.

  • Pure neon vector look - every line drawn, no sprites

  • Asteroid runs, alien arenas, boss fights

  • Reaction over memorization - no scripted waves, each enemy hunts you with its own behavior

  • Power-ups, helper drones, homing missiles and time-slowing stasis

  • Built for the mouse - one hand, autofire always on; gamepad fully supported

  • Short runs, instant restarts, old-school "one more go" scoring

  • Global Steam leaderboard - every run counts, race the whole world
short_desc: Wirehawk is a vertical shmup pairing classic vector-game aesthetics with modern, precise mouse control - a level of control and speed a gamepad simply can't match. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Gamepad supported, autofire always on.
